reconciliation.gross_revenue_basis: Per-property FY2024 rental income on the property cards is disclosed WITHOUT FRS116 straight-lining (p26-42); those figures sum to ~S$92.0m. On the same basis reported rental income = 102,210 (Note 17) - straight-lining 10,227 = 91,983k. income_stmt_metrics.total_revenue / performance.gross_revenue 102,211k INCLUDES the 10,227k straight-lining adjustment + 1k dividend income.
reconciliation.str_identity: Sum(revenue 102,211) - Sum(expense 51,957 incl tax) + Sum(adjustment -13,500) = 36,754 = net_income (Total return after income tax). PASS.
reconciliation.portfolio_valuation: Sum of 32 per-property SGD appraised values approximates disclosed portfolio value 1,118.0m (Indonesia 839.9m + Japan 247.7m + Singapore 30.4m); minor rounding per AR note p25/p26.

parsing_traps: Statement of Total Return prints Group AND Trust columns side by side (5202-5226); Group is the consolidated figure used.
Property cards give appraised value twice (local currency then SGD); SGD figure taken as market_valuation.
Some property-card values render as flat <div> grids (Bali/TB Simatupang p38) rather than key-value tables.
quirks: Property tables are stacked-cell one-card-per-property (healthcare style) -> properties extracted llm_only from markdown, not the HTML adapter (REFERENCE §2 taxonomy).
Japan property purchase prices disclosed only in JPY; left null with note. Indonesia & Singapore purchase prices in S$.
Some Indonesia assets are dual (hospital+mall or hospital+hotel) with two sub-expiries; anchor expiry (hospital / 31 Dec 2035) used for lease_expiry_date, both retained in tenure_raw.
